reviews.title: Sometimes it works for 45 seconds to a minute.
reviews.text: Sometimes it works for 45 seconds to a minute. Then an add shows which is expected since it is free to use. The problem is most of the adds do not close and have no “x” box to close after the ad plays to the end. So to get back to the remote we then close it completely and re-open it. Damn now it wants me to type the numeric code from the tv into the app to connect to the tv. Type it in perfect, wrong code entered. Repeat a couple times. After 5th attempt I can now use it to navigate the tv menus. Go to search a movie by typing title in the search box. Get three letters In , damn an ad starts to play. I watch it waiting for the finish to regain control. Damn the ad doesn’t close. Now I will close and reopen the app. And then I repeat the process outlined above….. I miss our analog remote. Been missing too long.
